findings.title: Non-BMP text corrupts LSP positions and rename edits
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: VS Code applies a rename that damages surrounding source; ASCII/BMP controls work.
findings.crosscheck: Independent protocol and actual VS Code

findings.title: Typed function header comments panic analysis
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Ordinary trailing comments panic CLI/check and an LSP diagnostic worker; a suppression action can create this source. Server recovery was observed.
findings.crosscheck: Independent CLI and LSP comment controls

findings.title: Same-name modules leak across workspace projects
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Two individually valid projects resolve a foreign module, producing wrong types, definitions and false diagnostics.
findings.crosscheck: Independent differently named projects plus standalone controls

findings.title: Shadowed local functions resolve the outer contract
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Checker, hover and signature help can agree on the wrong declaration and reject valid inner calls.

findings.title: Contextual callback return contracts are skipped
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Invalid callback returns are accepted on common direct-call and typed-initializer paths while consumers are shown the declared result type.
findings.crosscheck: Independent fixture and emitted-Lua runtime oracle

findings.title: Call-result property chains bypass type contracts
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: A number property after a call accepts a string assignment even when hover knows the number type.
findings.crosscheck: Independent fixture and emitted-Lua runtime oracle

findings.title: Native instance inference depends on assignment whitespace
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Removing spaces around = loses the class receiver in hover, completion and signature help. Checker rejection still works.

findings.title: Invoked identifier completion bypasses autoimports
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Explicitly invoked completion omits a project symbol available through other request contexts.
findings.crosscheck: Independent protocol and actual VS Code suggestion UI

findings.title: Completion replacement ignores right-hand syntax
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Accepting a candidate can retain a token suffix or duplicate an existing call.
findings.crosscheck: Returned edits applied and checked; independent suffix fixture

findings.title: Asset paths are inserted without quote escaping
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: A filename containing the active string delimiter creates invalid source.
findings.crosscheck: Applied edits and independent opposite-quote fixture

findings.title: Quoted record keys become invalid dot accesses
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Reserved or non-identifier keys are inserted as bare members.
findings.crosscheck: Applied edits and independent reserved-key fixture

findings.title: Snippet capability negotiation is ignored
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Clients explicitly declining snippets still receive snippet format and placeholders; this is not a VS Code-specific defect.
findings.crosscheck: Actual protocol requests with snippetSupport false

findings.title: Native vararg annotations lose their element type
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Wrong trailing arguments are accepted and useful type information disappears from editor surfaces.
findings.crosscheck: Native and LuaDoc controls across checker and editor

findings.title: Final multi-return arguments are counted syntactically
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Valid Lua-style consume(pair()) calls are rejected for missing arguments.

findings.title: Definitely absent assignment slots infer any
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Known nil assignment slots silently lose their useful type and permit incompatible contracts.

findings.title: Method-token hover loses call-chain identity
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: LOVE method hover is absent or shows the entire expression result despite usable completion/signature/definition data.
findings.crosscheck: Independent Font and Canvas chain fixtures

findings.title: Class normalization breaks expression hover coordinates
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Expression hover can disappear, report an unrelated type, or return a range beyond the document.
findings.crosscheck: Independent native-class prefix and arithmetic controls

findings.title: Optional parameters are displayed as required
findings.confidence: high (observed behavior); root cause inferred from source
findings.impact: Optional/default parameters look required; optional forms merely display nilability despite different accepted call arity.
